claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
The funded work is a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer for 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, beginning after the existing contract closes.
UTxO RPC is an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers with SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python to standardize interactions with UTxO-based blockchains.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as an ecosystem standard.
The project maintains more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations, and is open source under Apache 2.0.
The maintainer scope includes protobuf specification maintenance, official SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

TxPipe is reported to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC being delivered on schedule.

Intersect plans to manage the funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with named TRSC and PSSC addresses, external oversight entities, defined multi-party authorization thresholds, milestone metadata, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance grant administered by Intersect, with claims of ecosystem adoption, prior delivery history, Hydra voting approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury controls.
